name: Nathan Auyeng
bio: Nathan came from the AMNH [Science Research Mentoring Program,](https://www.amnh.org/learn-teach/grades-9-12/science-research-mentoring-program) and volunteered at the Arachnida collections during the summer of 2018. He assisted with curatorial activities, helping to curate important collections of spiders and other arachnids, under the supervision of Lou Sorkin and Pío Colmenares.
